items.title: 〈美股盤後〉Anthropic IPO重燃AI熱情 晶片股反攻 費半勁揚約3%
items.title_en: <US After-Hours> Anthropic IPO Rekindles AI Enthusiasm, Chip Stocks Rally, Philly Semiconductor Index Up About 3%
paras: Anthropic 提交首次公開發行 (IPO) 申請，重新點燃人工智慧 (AI) 投資熱情，加上油價回落緩解通膨疑慮，美股主要指數週一 (26 日) 同步收高。道瓊上漲逾 146 點，標普500指數漲0.70%，終止連兩個交易日跌勢，美光等晶片股強彈，那斯達克指數上揚約0.8%，費半勁揚近3%。
Claude 開發商 Anthropic 公開提交 IPO 申請，計劃以「ANT」為股票代碼在那斯達克掛牌，為近期承壓的 AI 題材注入信心，帶動晶片股領漲。
申報文件顯示，公司上半年營收達162.9億美元，較去年同期暴增約 13 倍。在市場擔憂資料中心支出難以持續、標普500與那指連續兩週收跌之際，這起上市案也將成為檢驗投資人對 AI 產業信心的重要指標。
布蘭特油價上週五一度升至4月以來最高，當時有報導指出，美國與以色列可能在期中選舉後對伊朗發動攻擊。儘管國際油價週一回落，中東供應風險仍未消退，美國戰略石油準備上週降至2.826億桶，為1982年10月以來最低。
投資人本週將迎接科技巨頭財報與聯準會 (Fed) 利率決議。本週有163家標普500成分企業預定公布第3季業績，其中包括 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)。在 Meta 上週財報引發市場不安後，華爾街將特別關注這些公司的 AI 支出展望、投資回報與融資需求。
Fed 則將於週三公布利率決議。聯邦基金利率期貨顯示，市場預估維持利率在3.75%至4%區間的機率約90%，主席華許對通膨與後續升息的說法將是焦點。
美股週一 (26 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.88%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 1.10%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 1.06%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 1.54%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 0.44%。
半導體主要個股全面收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 2.80%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 2.33%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.39%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 2.74%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 2.10%。
記憶體與儲存族群普升。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.98%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 大漲 3.63%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 上漲 1.42%；希捷 (STX-US) 上漲 2.18%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 勁揚 4.09%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.40%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 大漲 3.15%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.54%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.76%。
企業新聞
巴西總統魯拉在週日總統大選中意外勝出，巴西企業在美上市股票重挫。啤酒商 Ambev (ABEV-US) 暴跌超14%，巴西石油公司 (PBR-US) 慘崩約 14%，投資管理公司 XP (XP-US) 跌超48%，近乎腰斬。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲1.5% 至每股 532.60 美元。公司將向約6萬名員工提供自願離職補償方案，相當於全職員工總數約27%，藉此降低成本，並調整 AI 時代的人力配置。
SpaceX (SPCX-US) 下跌0.4%至每股 146.90 美元。公司與阿波羅全球管理公司達成約400億美元設備融資租賃協議，用於取得 AI 晶片。
馬斯克還表示，提供 AI 算力服務的新型雲端業者，將面臨他形容如「小魚般大量死亡、相互整併」的洗牌，因為債市已不再願意借錢給這些公司。
不過，相關個股漲跌互見。CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 上漲約1.8%，IREN (IREN-US) 上漲2.1%，Nebius (NBIS-US) 則大跌3.5%。
Meta (META-US) 下跌1.9% 至每股 630.56 美元。公司計劃透過普通股與特別股籌資，總額最高達950億美元，支持 AI 發展。其中，近期將發行350億美元股票，明年還可能再發行600億美元股票。
華爾街分析
Freedom Capital Markets 市場策略師 Jay Woods 表示，市場需要 Anthropic 這類消息提振信心，就如同先前的 SpaceX。他預期，這起備受期待的上市案將吸引投資需求。
盈透證券首席策略師 Steve Sosnick 也指出，Anthropic 重新喚起市場近幾週缺乏的 AI 熱情，這起 IPO 將是檢驗投資人態度與承接意願的重要測試。
不過，Treasury Partners 創始合夥人兼投資長 Richard Saperstein 認為，科技巨頭財報的關鍵，在於未來打算投入多少 AI 支出，以及營運現金流是否足以支應，或仍需透過發股與舉債籌資。
對於 Fed，他預期週三不會升息，因為自上次會議以來，債市已透過殖利率上升收緊信用條件。他預期 Fed 將對通膨維持強硬措辭，但政策行動相對溫和。
信安資產管理的 Seema Shah 則認為，這一輪緊縮主要回應能源帶動的通膨與匯率變化，並非經濟明顯過熱，因此升息循環可能相對有限，但她仍預期 Fed 將於12月升息，並在2027年再升息一次。

paras_en: Anthropic filed its initial public offering (IPO) application, reigniting enthusiasm for artificial intelligence (AI) investments. Coupled with a drop in oil prices easing inflation concerns, the major U.S. equity indices all closed higher on Monday (the 26th). The Dow rose more than 146 points, the S&P 500 gained 0.70% to end a two‑day losing streak, chip stocks such as Micron jumped, the Nasdaq climbed about 0.8%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged nearly 3%.

Anthropic, the developer of Claude, publicly submitted its IPO filing and plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT,” injecting confidence into the AI theme that has been under pressure and leading the rally in chip stocks.

The filing shows the company generated $16.29 billion in revenue in the first half of the year, roughly 13 times its revenue a year earlier. At a time when the market worries that data‑center spending may not be sustainable and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq have posted two consecutive weeks of declines, this listing will serve as a key barometer of investors’ confidence in the AI sector.

Brent crude spiked to its highest level since April last Friday, when reports suggested the United States and Israel might launch attacks on Iran after the mid‑term elections. Although international oil prices fell on Monday, Middle‑East supply risks have not disappeared, and U.S. strategic petroleum reserves dropped to 282.6 million barrels last week—the lowest level since October 1982.

Investors this week will face earnings reports from tech giants and the Federal Reserve’s interest‑rate decision. A total of 163 S&P 500 constituents are slated to release third‑quarter results, including Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US). After Meta’s earnings last week unsettled the market, Wall Street will closely watch these companies’ AI‑spending outlooks, returns on investment and financing needs.

The Fed is set to announce its rate decision on Wednesday. Federal‑funds futures indicate the market assigns roughly a 90% probability that rates will stay in the 3.75%‑4% range, and Chair Jerome Powell’s comments on inflation and any further hikes will be a focal point.
U.S. equity indices on Monday (the 26th) performed as follows:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 146.42 points, or 0.28%, to 52,361.58. The Nasdaq Composite gained 214.04 points, or 0.83%, to 26,169.38. The S&P 500 climbed 53.09 points, or 0.70%, to 7,676.77. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 304.01 points, or 2.82%, to 11,083.47. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 77.24 points, or 0.42%, to 18,290.69.

Among the five big‑tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index, performance was mixed: Meta (META‑US) fell 1.88%; Apple (AAPL‑US) slipped 1.10%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) dropped 1.06%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 1.54%; and Amazon (AMZN‑US) gained 0.44%.

Major semiconductor stocks all closed in the green. AMD (AMD‑US) rose 2.80%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) up 2.33%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) up 2.39%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) up 2.74%; and Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) up 2.10%.

Memory and storage stocks generally advanced. Micron (MU‑US) climbed 2.98%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) surged 3.63%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) up 1.42%; Seagate (STX‑US) up 2.18%; and SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) jumped 4.09%.

Taiwan‑related ADRs saw more gains than losses. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose 1.40%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) surged 3.15%; United Microelectronics ADR (UMC‑US) up 1.54%; and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) slipped 0.76%.
Corporate news

Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula’s surprise victory in Sunday’s presidential election sent Brazilian companies listed in the U.S. sharply lower. Beer maker Ambev (ABEV‑US) tumbled more than 14%, Petrobras (PBR‑US) fell about 14%, and investment‑management firm XP (XP‑US) dropped over 48%, nearly halving its value.

Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 1.5% to $532.60 per share. The company will offer a voluntary separation package to roughly 60,000 employees—about 27% of its full‑time workforce—to cut costs and re‑align staffing for the AI era.
SpaceX (SPCX‑US) slipped 0.4% to $146.90 per share. The firm reached a roughly $40 billion equipment‑financing lease agreement with Apollo Global Management to acquire AI chips.
Elon Musk also warned that new cloud providers offering AI compute services will face a “massive fish‑die‑off and consolidation” as the bond market no longer wants to lend to them.
Nevertheless, related stocks moved in both directions. CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) rose about 1.8%, IREN (IREN‑US) gained 2.1%, while Nebius (NBIS‑US) dropped 3.5%.

Meta (META‑US) fell 1.9% to $630.56 per share. The company plans to raise up to $95 billion through common and preferred stock to fund AI development, including a $35 billion issuance now and a potential $60 billion issuance next year.
Wall Street commentary

Freedom Capital Markets strategist Jay Woods said the market needs confidence‑boosting news like Anthropic’s, similar to the earlier SpaceX story, and expects the highly anticipated listing to attract strong investor demand.

Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick noted that Anthropic revives the AI enthusiasm that has been missing in recent weeks, making the IPO a crucial test of investor sentiment and willingness to allocate capital.

However, Treasury Partners founder and CIO Richard Saperstein argued that the key to tech‑giant earnings will be how much they plan to spend on AI and whether operating cash flow can support it, or if they will still need to raise money through equity or debt.

Regarding the Fed, he expects no rate hike on Wednesday because bond markets have already tightened credit conditions by pushing yields higher since the last meeting. He foresees the Fed maintaining a tough stance on inflation while taking relatively modest policy action.

Seema Shah of XinAn Asset Management believes this tightening cycle is mainly a response to energy‑driven inflation and currency moves rather than an overheating economy, so the rate‑hike cycle may be limited. Nonetheless, she still expects a Fed hike in December and another in 2027.

paras_en: Micron (MICR‑US) and its Taichung union reached a labor‑management agreement, with over 80% of staff receiving salary hikes of about 2.7 times. Production‑line workers’ annual pay rises to more than NT$2 million, while junior and senior engineers can earn up to NT$4 million and NT$6 million respectively. The mandatory pension contribution also increases to 10%. The Ministry of Economic Affairs said on the evening of the 22nd it welcomed the consensus and hopes the Taoyuan plant will continue dialogue to create a win‑win outcome.

The boards of four state‑owned financial holding companies—First Financial Holding (2892‑TW), Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW), Cooperative Financial Holding (5880‑TW) and Hua Nan Financial Holding (2880‑TW)—and their respective asset‑management subsidiaries—First Financial Investment Trust, Mega International Investment Trust, Cooperative Bank Investment Trust and Hua Nan Yong‑Chang Investment Trust—approved on the 22nd a consolidation plan for the four trust companies. The plan designates First Financial Investment Trust, the largest and best‑performing manager, as the surviving entity.

The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research released its September business‑climate index on the 23rd. Both the manufacturing and construction sectors saw their indices rise, while the services sector recorded a decline for the third consecutive month. Manufacturing’s index continued to hit new highs but only inched upward, leading the institute to note that firms’ outlook on the economy remained broadly unchanged from the previous month.

Benefiting from sustained demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud data services, as well as a surge in inventory buildup for new consumer‑electronics products, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced on the 23rd that September’s industrial production index was 140.76, up 19.17% year‑on‑year. The manufacturing production index reached 143.31, a 20.21% annual increase. Both indices set record highs for the month and marked the 31st consecutive month of growth. Looking ahead to October, the ministry forecasts the manufacturing production index to range between 141.56 and 145.86, implying a year‑on‑year rise of 20.5% to 24.2%.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced on the 23rd that its board approved capital injections into subsidiaries in Singapore, France and the Czech Republic amounting to US$1.101 billion, US$58 million and US$44 million respectively, for a total of US$1.203 billion to be used for long‑term investments.

items.title: 8400億！高盛示警美股新考驗：散戶熱情快腰斬  「這類人」成關鍵支撐
items.title_en: 84 Billion! Goldman Sachs Warns of a New Test for US Stocks: Retail Investor Enthusiasm Slashed, “These People” Become Key Support
paras: 在美股波動加劇、機構持續減倉之際，散戶正悄然退潮。高盛最新報告顯示，美國散戶股票交易活躍度較今年夏季下降約20%，較2025年底更大幅回落45%，散戶買入意願明顯減弱，而市場對家庭資金的需求卻不斷上升。
高盛首席美股策略師Ben Snider指出，散戶交易目前僅佔美股總成交量的約9%，低於去年底的15%，接近2020年以來最低水平。
高盛認為，消費者信心疲軟、能源價格上漲及債券殖利率攀升是核心因素。同時，該行預計2026年美國實際收入增幅僅約1%，居民消費韌性部分依賴儲蓄率下降。
儘管過去兩週散戶交易略有回升，部分投資者重新「逢低買入」，但資金流入尚不足以扭轉近期調整。
標普500指數上周累計下跌約2.4%，大型科技企業的AI資本支出及融資需求引發市場擔憂。法人機構同樣在緊縮曝險部位，上周四(22日)，多類避險基金單日跌幅均超1%，為新冠疫情期間以來首次，當天亦成為今年相關股票波動第二劇烈的交易日。
散戶資金還面臨其他市場分流。Snider表示，預測市場月度交易量已從一年前的約50億美元飆升至780億美元，槓桿ETF中的散戶交易佔比約為非槓桿ETF的兩倍。
但高盛認為，預測市場整體規模仍有限，散戶活躍度下降與消費者信心、儲蓄率及能源價格的變化更為一致。
值得關注的是，短線交易熱情降溫的同時，美國家庭整體對股票的需求依然強勁。根據Fed數據，今年上半年美國家庭淨買入約8400億美元美國股票，股票共同基金及ETF年內累計吸引約3500億美元資金流入。
高盛估算，自主交易證券帳戶中的股票資產約12兆美元，僅佔家庭直接和間接持有的約65兆美元股票資產的18%，退休帳戶等長期配置通路仍是持股主力。
然而，家庭持股高度集中於富裕群體。最富有的10%美國家庭持有家庭股票資產總額的約87%，其中前1%獨佔約47%，後50%家庭持有比例僅約1%。持續買入和市場上漲已推高家庭資產配置中股票權重至約55%，創歷史最高水平。
展望後市，高盛預估2027年美國公開股票市場的淨供應增幅將達2000年以來最高，企業融資需求增加、大型IPO推進及限售股解禁將帶來新的供應壓力。
Snider指出，勞動力市場和利率變化將在很大程度上決定家庭股票需求，近期宏觀波動表明資金持續流入的預測仍面臨不確定性。
paras_en: As US stock volatility intensifies and institutions continue to reduce positions, retail investors are quietly retreating. Goldman Sachs' latest report shows that US retail stock trading activity has fallen about 20% compared with this summer, and a much larger drop of 45% compared with the end of 2025, with retail buying appetite clearly weakening, while market demand for household funds keeps rising.

Goldman Sachs chief US equity strategist Ben Snider notes that retail trading now accounts for only about 9% of total US equity turnover, down from 15% at the end of last year, near the lowest level since 2020.

Goldman says weak consumer confidence, rising energy prices and climbing bond yields are the core factors. At the same time, the firm forecasts that US real income growth in 2026 will be only about 1%, and the resilience of household consumption will partly depend on a declining savings rate.
Although retail trading has slightly rebounded over the past two weeks, with some investors buying on dips again, inflows are still insufficient to reverse the recent correction.

The S&P 500 fell about 2.4% last week, and the AI capital spending and financing needs of large tech firms have raised market concerns. Institutional investors are also tightening exposure; on Thursday (the 22nd), several hedge fund categories posted daily declines of over 1%, the first such occurrence since the COVID‑19 pandemic, making the day the second most volatile trading day this year for related stocks.

Retail funds also face other market outflows. Snider says that the forecast market’s monthly trading volume has surged from about $5 billion a year ago to $78 billion, and retail trading in leveraged ETFs is roughly twice that in non‑leveraged ETFs.
But Goldman believes the overall size of the forecast market remains limited, and the drop in retail activity aligns more closely with changes in consumer confidence, savings rates and energy prices.

Worth noting, while short‑term trading enthusiasm cools, overall US household demand for stocks remains strong. Fed data show that in the first half of this year US households net bought about $840 billion of US equities, and stock mutual funds and ETFs attracted roughly $350 billion of inflows year‑to‑date.

Goldman estimates that stock assets in self‑directed brokerage accounts total about $12 trillion, only 18% of the roughly $65 trillion of stock assets held directly or indirectly by households, with retirement accounts and other long‑term vehicles still the main holders.

However, household stock holdings are highly concentrated among the wealthy. The richest 10% of US households own about 87% of total household stock assets, with the top 1% alone holding about 47%, while the bottom 50% hold only about 1%. Ongoing buying and market gains have pushed the stock weight in household asset allocations up to about 55%, a historic high.

Looking ahead, Goldman projects that net supply in the US public equity market in 2027 will rise to the highest level since 2000, as corporate financing needs increase, large IPOs advance and lock‑up expirations add new supply pressure.

Snider points out that labor market conditions and interest‑rate changes will largely determine household stock demand, and recent macro volatility shows that forecasts of continued inflows remain uncertain.

items.title: 美債殖利率回落！Fed暫停升息理由受考驗 華許如何說服市場？
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Fall! Fed's Pause on Rate Hikes Tested, How Will Waller Convince the Market?
paras: 根據《路透》報導，美國公債殖利率先前急升，曾讓聯準會(Fed)官員擔心金融環境收緊過快，成為本周暫停升息的重要考量。但隨著上周股市重挫、資金轉向公債避險，殖利率已回落，讓主席華許面臨更棘手的溝通考驗：如何解釋維持利率不變，同時讓市場相信Fed仍有決心壓制通膨。
市場普遍預期，Fed將在10月27日至28日會議維持基準利率於3.75%至4%。截至上周五，利率期貨反映按兵不動的機率達90%，但部分經濟學家認為，最新數據其實支持再次升息，決策可能比市場想像更接近兩難。

長債曾替Fed踩煞車 殖利率回落增添變數

Nationwide首席經濟學家Kathy Bostjancic表示，Fed上次會議以來的數據顯示，經濟、消費與勞動市場依然強勁，通膨卻朝錯誤方向發展。她認為，單從數據判斷，本周有理由升息。
不過，9月升息後，美國10年期公債殖利率攀至近四分之一世紀高點，讓決策官員擔心，市場利率上升可能使經濟放緩幅度超出原先預期。包括紐約聯準銀行總裁John Williams與Fed副主席Philip Jefferson在內的官員，隨後釋出願意等待更多數據的訊號，促使市場大幅降低升息押注。
如今，AI需求能否持續的疑慮引發股市賣壓，資金轉向公債，帶動殖利率回落。華許過去曾將金融環境收緊，視為降低政策利率進一步調升必要性的因素；債市走勢逆轉，也使這項判斷更為複雜。

暫停不能被解讀為鬆懈 華許須守住抗通膨可信度

EY-Parthenon首席經濟學家Gregory Daco認為，華許必須說明為何10月選擇不動，同時維持市場對後續仍可能升息的預期，避免傷害Fed的抗通膨可信度。
Daco警告，若華許未能傳達足夠訊號，只表示繼續等待通膨降溫的證據，市場可能質疑Fed的政策決心，進而推升公債殖利率，對經濟造成比一次升息更劇烈的衝擊。
11月3日期中選舉將決定共和黨能否維持國會兩院控制權，也讓此次溝通更加敏感。Daco表示，無論Fed做出何種決定，都可能被政治陣營解讀為偏袒對手，因此華許必須消除政策受政治影響的印象。
然而，考量華許不喜歡提供前瞻指引，Daco等經濟學家預期，他未必會明確預告下一步。投資人將仔細檢視會後聲明與記者會，尤其是他如何描述金融環境，以及持續高於目標的通膨威脅。

決策隔天迎PCE與GDP 通膨壓力恐不限能源

Fed仍有理由耐心觀望。過去六個月，時薪增幅低於通膨，顯示勞動市場並未對物價施加太大壓力。9月會議紀錄也顯示，許多官員將當次升息視為防範通膨風險的預防措施；若中東衝突獲得解決，相關壓力可能開始緩解。
但會議結束隔天公布的數據，可能凸顯抗通膨工作尚未完成。經濟學家預估，9月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)年增率將由8月的3.4%升至3.6%，除中東衝突推高汽油價格外，機票、租金與電腦等項目也帶來壓力。
同日公布的經濟數據預料將顯示，上季美國經濟成長加速，主要由穩健消費及AI需求帶動的企業投資支撐。勞動市場也維持穩定，9月失業率為4.2%，每周初領失業金人數處於低檔。
BMO美國首席經濟學家Scott Anderson認為，這次決策將比市場定價所反映的更難取捨，至少可能出現克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁Beth Hammack反對按兵不動，其他官員也可能加入。
Anderson目前預期，Fed還需升息兩次才能控制通膨。他表示，從現有情勢來看，Fed仍有更多工作要做。
paras_en: According to Reuters, the sharp rise in U.S. Treasury yields earlier this week had worried Federal Reserve officials that financial conditions were tightening too quickly, becoming a key factor in the decision to pause rate hikes. However, after last week’s equity market plunge and a shift of capital into Treasury safe‑havens, yields have fallen, putting Chair Waller in a tougher spot: he must explain why rates stay unchanged while convincing the market that the Fed remains determined to curb inflation.

The market broadly expects the Fed to keep the target rate at 3.75%‑4% at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting. As of last Friday, rate‑futures implied a 90% probability of a hold, but some economists argue that the latest data actually support another hike, making the decision potentially more of a dilemma than the market assumes.

Long‑term bonds had previously acted as a brake for the Fed, and the yield decline adds a new variable. Nationwide chief economist Kathy Bostjancic said that data since the last meeting show the economy, consumer spending and the labor market remain strong, while inflation is moving in the wrong direction. She believes the data alone give a reason to raise rates this week.

However, after the September hike, the 10‑year Treasury yield rose to near a 25‑year high, causing policymakers to worry that higher market rates could slow the economy more than expected. Officials such as New York Fed President John Williams and Fed Vice‑Chair Philip Jefferson later signaled a willingness to wait for more data, prompting the market to sharply cut its rate‑hike bets.

Now concerns over whether AI demand can be sustained have weighed on equities, pushing money into Treasuries and pulling yields down. Waller has previously viewed a tightening financial environment as a factor that could reduce the need for further policy‑rate hikes; the bond‑market reversal makes that assessment more complex.

A pause must not be read as laxity – Waller must preserve the Fed’s credibility on fighting inflation. EY‑Parthenon chief economist Gregory Daco says Waller needs to explain why October is a hold while keeping market expectations that further hikes are possible, to avoid damaging the Fed’s anti‑inflation credibility.

Daco warns that if Waller fails to send a strong enough signal and merely says the Fed will keep waiting for inflation to cool, markets may question the Fed’s resolve, pushing Treasury yields higher and hurting the economy more than a single hike would.

The November 3 midterm elections, which will decide whether Republicans retain control of both chambers of Congress, add sensitivity to the communication. Daco notes that whatever the Fed decides could be portrayed by political camps as favoring the opponent, so Waller must dispel any impression that policy is politically driven.

Nevertheless, given Waller’s aversion to forward guidance, Daco and other economists expect he may not give a clear preview of the next step. Investors will scrutinize the post‑meeting statement and press conference, especially how he describes the financial environment and the still‑elevated inflation threat.

The Fed still has reasons to be patient. Over the past six months, wage growth has lagged inflation, indicating the labor market is not exerting strong price pressure. The September meeting minutes also show many officials viewed that hike as a preventive measure against inflation risk; if Middle‑East tensions ease, related pressures could start to recede.

But data released the day after the meeting could highlight that the anti‑inflation fight is far from over. Economists forecast the September personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index to rise from August’s 3.4% annual rate to 3.6%, with gasoline price spikes from Middle‑East conflict, plus pressure from airfare, rents and computers.

The same day’s economic releases are expected to show that U.S. economic growth accelerated in the fourth quarter, driven mainly by solid consumer spending and corporate investment spurred by AI demand. The labor market also remained stable, with September unemployment at 4.2% and weekly initial claims at a low level.

BMO chief U.S. economist Scott Anderson says this decision will be harder than market pricing suggests, with at least a dissent from Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack against a hold and possibly other officials joining the opposition.
Anderson currently expects the Fed will need two more hikes to bring inflation under control. He says that, given the current situation, the Fed still has more work to do.

items.title: AI投資回報惹疑慮！高盛：趨勢型避險基金創2024年來最差一周
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Warns AI Investment Returns Raise Concerns; Trend-Following Hedge Funds Record Worst Week of 2024
paras: 路透周一(26日)取得的高盛(GS-US)報告顯示，市場對AI巨額支出能否帶來回報的疑慮，引發股債市場波動，追蹤市場趨勢的避險基金上周遭遇2024年以來最差單周表現，科技股也持續面臨賣壓。
那斯達克100指數上周下跌5.5%，創2025年4月以來最大單周跌幅。當時，美國總統川普宣布「解放日」關稅，曾引發全球市場動盪；這次市場焦點則轉向AI投資的資金需求與獲利前景。
Meta(META-US)是拖累大盤的因素之一，股價上周重挫10%。儘管財報表現強勁，公司卻透露，仍需籌集更多資金支應AI投資，令投資人不安，也使科技業持續擴張的財務負擔受到關注。
債市同樣震盪，投資人轉向相對安全的美國公債，同時拋售法國等經濟體較脆弱國家的債券，顯示避險需求升溫之際，資金也更審慎區分不同市場的風險。
高盛指出，以演算法追蹤市場趨勢的系統性多空策略，上周下跌2%，為2024年以來最差表現；依據企業基本面選股的多空策略則再跌1.1%。這類策略同時持有多頭與空頭部位，但仍受到近期市場波動衝擊。
本月迄今，基本面多空策略累計下跌3.8%，今年仍上漲8.8%；系統性策略10月以來下跌1.1%，今年則仍有18.7%的漲幅。近期回撤雖侵蝕部分報酬，兩類策略年初至今仍維持正報酬。
部位調整方面，個股出現7月下旬以來最大規模的多空部位同步縮減。美股已連續三周遭淨賣出，近五周中有四周呈現資金撤出，反映避險基金持續降低市場曝險。
高盛主經紀業務部門另指出，過去兩周科技股賣出規模達200億美元，已接近7月大規模平倉時的230億美元，凸顯這波科技股減碼力道。
paras_en: Reuters obtained a Goldman Sachs (GS-US) report on Monday (the 26th) showing that doubts over whether massive AI spending can deliver returns have sparked volatility in equity and bond markets, and trend‑following hedge funds tracking the market suffered their worst single‑week performance since the start of 2024, while tech stocks continued to face selling pressure.

The Nasdaq‑100 fell 5.5% last week, marking its biggest weekly drop since April 2025. At that time, former U.S. President Trump announced a “Liberation Day” tariff that had rattled global markets; this time the focus shifted to the funding needs and profit outlook of AI investments.

Meta (META-US) was one of the drag on the broader market, with its stock plunging 10% last week. Although its earnings were strong, the company disclosed that it still needs to raise additional capital to fund AI projects, unsettling investors and highlighting the financial burden of continued expansion in the tech sector.

The bond market also wavered, with investors moving into relatively safe U.S. Treasuries while selling bonds from more vulnerable economies such as France, indicating that as hedging demand rises, capital is becoming more discerning about risk across different markets.

Goldman Sachs noted that systematic long‑short strategies that use algorithms to track market trends fell 2% last week, the worst performance since 2024 began; fundamental‑based long‑short strategies slipped another 1.1%. These strategies hold both long and short positions but were still hit by recent market turbulence.

To date this month, fundamental long‑short strategies have fallen a cumulative 3.8%, though they are up 8.8% for the year; systematic strategies have dropped 1.1% since October, yet remain up 18.7% year‑to‑date. Recent pullbacks have eroded part of the gains, but both strategy types still show positive returns year‑to‑date.

In terms of position adjustments, individual stock long‑short exposures have shrunk to their largest reduction since late July. U.S. equities have seen net selling for three consecutive weeks, and out of the past five weeks, four have shown capital outflows, reflecting hedge funds’ ongoing reduction of market exposure.

Goldman Sachs’ prime brokerage division also pointed out that tech‑stock selling over the past two weeks reached $20 billion, close to the $23 billion sold during the large‑scale unwind in July, underscoring the strength of the current tech‑stock reduction.

items.title: 上市才幾天螢幕就裂！部分iPhone Duo用戶反映災情 蘋果展開調查
items.title_en: Screen Cracks Within Days of Launch! Some iPhone Duo Users Report Issues, Apple Launches Investigation
paras: 《彭博》周一(26日)報導，蘋果(AAPL-US)首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo上周五上市後，陸續有用戶反映，使用僅數小時至數天，內螢幕就在展開時出現裂痕，部分裝置甚至無法正常使用。蘋果員工透露，已有團隊調查問題，工程師也正嘗試取得故障裝置進行分析，但公司尚未公開回應。
這些通報最初出現在Reddit等社群平台，《彭博》隨後向至少七名用戶獨立查證，取得裝置損壞照片或與蘋果客服聯繫的紀錄。目前仍不清楚受影響裝置的比例及確切原因，多數iPhone Duo用戶似乎未遇到問題。

展開時出現異常阻力 用戶反映內螢幕破裂

受訪用戶描述的情況相當類似：展開手機時感到阻力增加，隨後聽見碎裂聲，中央摺痕附近出現明顯裂痕。部分裝置右側螢幕出現白斑或其他顯示異常，用戶也反映，裂痕起點附近的螢幕下方有凸起感。
聖地牙哥用戶Tom Battle表示，手機展開時比平常更卡、更難打開，開啟後便出現螢幕線條，還能感覺到顯示面板下方有凸起或鬆動零件。
創投人士Jonathan King則說，他原本打算分享正面使用心得，卻在周一展開手機時聽見碎裂聲。他的外螢幕仍可正常運作，內螢幕卻已無法使用，甚至在沒有碰觸的情況下出現誤觸反應。
另一名用戶Jainam Shah表示，手機鉸鏈原本運作正常，某次展開時卻突然明顯變緊，接著發出破裂聲，內螢幕立即出現明亮的垂直與水平線條。他強調，手機未曾摔落、遭受撞擊或承受異常壓力。

iFixit懷疑鉸鏈零件故障 確切原因仍待確認

維修平台iFixit研判，問題可能出在鉸鏈零件故障，進而造成螢幕破裂，而非顯示面板本身的缺陷。不過，這項推測尚未獲蘋果確認。
《彭博》表示，其使用的蘋果提供評測機，以及另一支自行購買的裝置，都沒有出現上述問題。蘋果發言人則未回應多次置評請求。
儘管目前問題似乎僅影響部分裝置，對投入逾十年開發、強調耐用性與鉸鏈技術的蘋果而言，仍是新品上市初期的一項挫折。
iPhone Duo是蘋果首度進軍摺疊手機市場，也是iPhone歷來最大幅度的設計變革。裝置外側配備較小螢幕，展開後則可使用較大的內螢幕，起價為1,999美元。
蘋果執行長特納斯(John Ternus)先前曾批評競爭對手的Android摺疊手機「廉價又粗糙」，硬體工程主管Tom Marieb也曾表示，消費者可以要求蘋果對螢幕摺痕的耐用性負責，使這波故障通報格外受到關注。

部分用戶已換機 缺貨與送修等待引發不滿

售後處理方面，部分用戶已取得替換機，但也有人因門市庫存或服務量能不足而等待。
維吉尼亞州一名用戶表示，當地蘋果門市認定裝置有瑕疵、需要更換，但沒有可預約的Genius Bar服務時段。他轉往另一間門市，經檢測確認並非意外損壞後，卻又因缺貨無法立即換機。
該用戶表示，可以理解第一代產品可能出現意外問題，但對售價如此高的手機，門市沒有可處理瑕疵換機的庫存，讓他相當失望。
也有換機順利的案例。紐約用戶Justin Lokos在第五大道門市取得替換機，並表示蘋果對其裝置啟動「早期現場故障分析」，詢問詳細使用情況。另一名印度用戶透過授權經銷商換機後，表示新裝置在最初24小時內未出現問題。
蘋果員工透露，公司目前尚未向零售門市或客服人員發布相關正式處理指引，但調查團隊已展開作業，部分工程師也正聯繫用戶、收集故障裝置，以釐清問題來源。
paras_en: Bloomberg reported on Monday (the 26th) that Apple’s (AAPL-US) first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, which went on sale last Friday, has seen users report that after only a few hours to a few days of use, the inner screen develops cracks when unfolded, with some devices even becoming unusable. Apple employees said a team is already investigating the problem, engineers are trying to obtain faulty units for analysis, but the company has not yet issued a public response.

The reports first appeared on social platforms such as Reddit, and Bloomberg later independently verified the accounts of at least seven users, obtaining photos of the damaged devices or records of contact with Apple support. It is still unclear what proportion of devices are affected or the exact cause, and most iPhone Duo owners appear not to have encountered any issues.

Users describe a very similar scenario: when unfolding the phone they feel increased resistance, then hear a cracking sound and see a clear fracture near the central hinge line. Some devices show white spots or other display anomalies on the right‑hand side of the screen, and users note a raised feeling under the screen near the crack’s origin point.

San Diego user Tom Battle said the phone feels noticeably stickier and harder to open than usual, and after opening it he saw lines on the screen and could feel a protrusion or loose component beneath the display panel.

Venture‑capitalist Jonathan King said he had intended to share a positive review, but on Monday, when he unfolded the phone, he heard a cracking sound. The outer screen still works, but the inner screen is dead and even registers phantom touches without any contact.

Another user, Jainam Shah, said the hinge worked fine until one time it suddenly tightened dramatically while opening, then emitted a breaking sound and the inner screen instantly filled with bright vertical and horizontal lines. He emphasized the phone had never been dropped, struck, or subjected to abnormal pressure.
Repair platform iFixit suspects a hinge‑component failure that leads to the screen cracking, rather than a defect in the display panel itself. This hypothesis has not been confirmed by Apple.

Bloomberg said that the Apple‑provided evaluation unit it used, as well as another device it purchased independently, showed no such problems. Apple spokespeople have not responded to multiple requests for comment.

Although the issue currently seems limited to a subset of units, it is a setback for Apple, which has spent over a decade developing the product and touting its durability and hinge technology as key selling points.

The iPhone Duo marks Apple’s first foray into the foldable‑phone market and represents the most radical design change in the iPhone line to date. The device features a small outer screen and a larger inner screen when unfolded, with a starting price of $1,999.

Apple CEO John Ternus has previously criticized rival Android foldables as “cheap and rough,” and hardware engineering head Tom Marieb has said consumers can expect Apple to stand behind the durability of its screen folds, making these failure reports especially noteworthy.
Some users have already received replacement phones, but others are waiting due to limited store inventory or service capacity.

A user in Virginia said the local Apple store deemed his device defective and in need of replacement, but no Genius Bar appointments were available. He went to another store, where technicians confirmed the damage was not accidental, yet he still could not get a replacement because of stock shortages.

The user said he understands that first‑generation products can have unexpected issues, but he is disappointed that a high‑priced phone cannot be swapped out promptly due to lack of inventory at the store.

There are also successful replacement cases. New York user Justin Lokos received a replacement at the Fifth Avenue store, noting that Apple initiated an “early on‑site failure analysis” and asked detailed usage questions. An Indian user who swapped his device through an authorized reseller said the new phone showed no problems in the first 24 hours.

Apple employees disclosed that the company has not yet issued formal handling guidelines to retail stores or support staff, but the investigation team is already active, with some engineers contacting users and collecting faulty units to pinpoint the root cause.

items.title: 從最高加碼退到中立！匯豐看股市信心降溫 點名中東與AI風險
items.title_en: From Highest Overweight to Neutral! HSBC Sees Market Confidence Cooling, Flags Middle East and AI Risks
paras: 《路透》周一(26日)報導，匯豐將全球股票配置建議由「最高加碼」降至「中立」，理由是中東地緣政治緊張再起，以及美國期中選舉前，市場對AI可能面臨更多監管的疑慮升溫。與此同時，匯豐將已開發市場主權債券由「最高減碼」大幅調升至「加碼」，反映其資產配置態度轉趨審慎。
匯豐在報告中表示，自3月中旬以來，一直維持股票最高加碼、主權債券最高減碼的立場，但市場關注的議題不斷變換，已難以維持先前相同程度的信心。
美國期中選舉是促使匯豐調整配置的重要變數。該行認為，若民主黨勝選，AI監管疑慮可能升高，進而拖慢產業發展，為主權債券帶來支撐；若選舉結果形成政治僵局，也可能舒緩市場對財政支出的擔憂，有利公債表現。
匯豐指出，博弈市場對民主黨大勝、形成「藍色浪潮」的押注，可能過於篤定。不過，若這種情境成真，AI監管疑慮仍可能成為市場短期內的另一項打擊。
股票配置方面，匯豐對歐元區與新興市場更加謹慎。歐元區主要受到法國相關疑慮影響，新興市場則面臨區域內偏空的AI投資情緒，削弱該行對股票的信心。
商品方面，匯豐也下調原先對黃金的「加碼」配置建議，但報導未交代調整後的具體評等；原油則獲調升至「加碼」。
paras_en: Reuters reported on Monday (the 26th) that HSBC has lowered its global equity allocation recommendation from "Highest Overweight" to "Neutral", citing renewed Middle‑East geopolitical tensions and growing market concerns that AI could face increased regulation ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. At the same time, HSBC has sharply upgraded its rating on developed‑market sovereign bonds from "Highest Underweight" to "Overweight", reflecting a more cautious stance on asset allocation.

In its report, HSBC said it has maintained a "Highest Overweight" stance on equities and a "Highest Underweight" stance on sovereign bonds since mid‑March, but the issues driving market attention have shifted continuously, making it difficult to sustain the same level of confidence as before.

The U.S. midterm elections are a key factor prompting HSBC to adjust its allocations. The bank believes that if the Democrats win, regulatory concerns around AI could rise, slowing industry development and providing support for sovereign bonds; if the election results lead to a political stalemate, concerns over fiscal spending may ease, benefiting public‑debt performance.

HSBC notes that betting heavily on a Democratic landslide – a "blue wave" – may be overly confident. Nevertheless, if that scenario materialises, AI‑regulation worries could still become another short‑term market drag.

On equities, HSBC is more cautious about the euro area and emerging markets. The euro area is mainly affected by concerns related to France, while emerging markets face a bearish AI‑investment sentiment within the region, weakening the bank’s confidence in stocks.
Regarding commodities, HSBC also cut its previous "Overweight" recommendation on gold, though the report did not disclose the new rating; oil, however, was upgraded to "Overweight".

items.title: 6萬人可申請！微軟推自願離職 副總裁也適用
items.title_en: Up to 60,000 Eligible! Microsoft Launches Voluntary Separation Program, Vice Presidents Included
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)周一(26日)宣布，向美國、加拿大、印度及英國部分員工提供自願離職方案，在擴大AI基礎設施投資之際，兼顧資金運用效率。知情人士透露，約6萬名員工具備申請資格，占全球22.3萬名員工約27%，但這不代表實際離職人數，公司也未設定此次方案的目標人數。
新方案適用於內部職級70級以下、含70級的員工，涵蓋範圍最高達副總裁層級。部分行銷、業務及工程團隊未參與，符合資格者須於12月決定是否接受，參加者將於12月31日離職。
微軟人資長Amy Coleman在員工備忘錄中表示，自願離職方案旨在增加組織調整彈性，並讓員工有更多方式規劃下一階段職涯，同時延續今年稍早自願退休計畫的經驗。
微軟4月首度推出自願退休計畫，約7%的美國員工具備資格，適用對象為資深總監及以下層級。公司7月表示，符合資格者中，逾30%選擇參加；此次方案則將適用職級向上擴大。微軟也曾在7月宣布裁員4,800人的計畫。
隨著AI運算需求攀升，微軟持續加碼資料中心，向Anthropic、OpenAI等業者供應雲端服務，也使財務承受壓力。今年第二季，微軟自由現金流為196.4億美元，雖仍維持正值，但較去年同期減少23%；同期雲端競爭對手Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)均出現負自由現金流。
微軟將於周三(28日)美股盤後公布第三季財報。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) announced on Monday (the 26th) that it is offering a voluntary separation program to certain employees in the United States, Canada, India and the United Kingdom, balancing capital efficiency as it expands AI infrastructure investment. Sources say roughly 60,000 employees meet the eligibility criteria, but this does not indicate the actual number who will leave, and the company has not set a target headcount for the program.

The new program applies to internal staff at level 70 or below, including level 70, covering positions up to the vice‑president tier. Some marketing, sales and engineering teams are excluded. Eligible employees must decide by December whether to accept, and participants will depart on December 31.

Microsoft’s chief human‑resources officer Amy Coleman wrote in an employee memo that the voluntary separation program is intended to increase organizational flexibility and give staff more options for planning the next stage of their careers, building on the experience of the voluntary retirement plan launched earlier this year.

Microsoft first introduced a voluntary retirement plan in April, with about 7% of U.S. staff eligible, targeting senior directors and below. The company said that more than 30% of those who qualified chose to participate; the current program expands eligibility to higher levels.

As demand for AI computing rises, Microsoft continues to expand data centers and provide cloud services to firms such as Anthropic and OpenAI, adding financial pressure. Nevertheless, in the second quarter of this year, cloud rivals Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) both reported negative free cash flow, while Microsoft remained in the positive.
Updates will follow.

items.title_en: Hot Stock: Zhongyou (1809-TW) Pursues Turnaround via New Materials Business, Rises 12.44% This Week and Reclaims All Moving Averages
paras: 中釉(1809-TW)近年積極轉型，旗下新材料事業中的螢光玻璃片新品效益持續擴大，成為營運助力，大盤上周跌破5日線，中釉卻在成交量爆量衝上5.1萬張挹注下，周漲12.44%，股價收47元，站上所有均線，周K收紅。
中釉產品線近年因AI崛起，新產品布局積極，由傳統磁磚與釉料製造持續轉型為新材料，今(2026)年從玻璃與陶瓷專業技術出發，除了跨足半導體關鍵材料領域，也在類晶玻璃陶瓷基板技術上取得突破性進展。
法人表示，中釉近年除了轉型研發高附加價值的「螢光玻璃片」與「電子陶瓷材料」，也成功打入LED與車用光電封裝應用，投入固態電池電解質隔離膜材料，讓轉型題材也成為市場追逐熱點。
在營運層面上，中釉上(9)月營收年增5.88%、月增 7.68%，單月營收創近 8 個月新高，近期訂單動能有穩定成長跡象，投資人後續可關注中釉在汽車螢光玻璃片、陶瓷基板與半導體材料等新產品線的放量進度，以及營收能否延續穩定年增與高階材料占比提升。
中釉目前旗下有三大事業，包括陶瓷事業部、建築材料事業部、新材料事業部；其中最受矚的是新材料事業，包括螢光玻璃片、低介電類晶玻璃陶瓷基板、固態電池用電解質隔離膜材料等三大產品線。
paras_en: Zhongyou (1809‑TW) has been actively transforming in recent years, and the new fluorescent glass sheet product in its new‑materials division continues to expand its benefits, becoming an operational boost. While the broader market fell below the 5‑day moving average last week, Zhongyou surged on a massive volume of 51,000 shares, gaining 12.44% for the week and closing at NT$47, above all moving averages, with a red weekly candlestick.

In recent years, driven by the rise of AI, Zhongyou’s product strategy has shifted aggressively from traditional tiles and glazes toward new materials. Starting in 2026, leveraging its glass and ceramic expertise, the company not only entered the semiconductor key‑materials arena but also achieved breakthrough progress in quasi‑crystalline glass‑ceramic substrate technology.

Institutional investors note that Zhongyou has, beyond developing high‑value‑added “fluorescent glass sheets” and “electronic ceramic materials,” successfully entered LED and automotive optoelectronic packaging markets, and is investing in solid‑state battery electrolyte separator materials, turning its transformation theme into a market‑hot topic.

On the operational side, Zhongyou’s revenue in September rose 5.88% year‑over‑year and 7.68% month‑over‑month, setting a near‑eight‑month high for a single month. Recent order flow shows steady growth, and investors can watch the scaling of new product lines such as automotive fluorescent glass sheets, ceramic substrates, and semiconductor materials, as well as whether revenue can maintain stable year‑over‑year growth and an increasing share of high‑end materials.

Zhongyou currently operates three major divisions: the Ceramic Division, the Building Materials Division, and the New Materials Division. The most watched is the New Materials Division, which includes three product lines: fluorescent glass sheets, low‑dielectric quasi‑crystalline glass‑ceramic substrates, and electrolyte separator membranes for solid‑state batteries.

items.title: iPhone Duo螢幕出包 鴻海人士：實際生產未受影響
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Screen Defect, Foxconn Staff: Actual Production Unaffected
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首部摺疊機iPhone Duo開售首周，就有果粉反應螢幕故障的問題。
目前傳播較為廣泛的兩個案例，一台來自中國上海陸家嘴國金中心Apple Store零售店，一台由一名澳洲用戶在Reddit平台上發帖。此外，還有少數用戶在社交平台上發帖，引起不小聲量。
消費者之間的使用情況和螢幕損壞程度有細微區別，但相對一致的是，iPhone Duo摺疊次數不多，在幾次到幾十次，在最後一次展開後，摺疊處出現異響，隨即下方出現3至5釐米長裂痕，螢幕右方與該裂痕頂點垂直處也出現裂痕。兩處裂痕呈白色像素帶狀，交點附近有不同大小黑斑。
問題可能出在iPhone Duo鉸鏈上。
iFixit發布的iPhone Duo拆解報告，針對近期消費者出現的螢幕故障問題做推測，原因可能在於手機閉合時中央支撐桿未能正確縮回，從而對螢幕施加過大壓力。
另外，引導鉸鏈運動的弧形導軌，在摺疊過程中會高於周圍組件，如果導軌未能按預期移動，也存在干擾螢幕的可能性。
據《界面新聞》26日（周一）報導，一名鴻海(2317-TW) 員工說，此次螢幕障礙原因與上述分析大致相近。
該鴻海員工還表示，在產能吃緊的狀態下，蘋果曾降低過一定良率質檢標準，以保證供應，這必然導致螢幕故障產品流入市場的機率變高。
儘管蘋果採取了小幅放寬標準的舉措，但從實際影響看來，iPhone Duo螢幕故障的機率沒想像中那麼高。經銷商稱，手機出現問題的頻率不高，暫未遇到售後問題。
在最新舉措上，前述鴻海人士表示，針對相關問題，iPhone Duo產線已緊急替換一批物料，目前實際生產未受影響，也暫未改變備貨策略。渠道人士表示，iPhone Duo今年備貨將在750萬台量級。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) saw reports of screen failures from fans within the first week of sales of its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo.

Two widely reported cases involve a unit from the Apple Store in Lujiazui, Shanghai, China, and another posted by an Australian user on Reddit, with a few other users also posting on social platforms, generating noticeable buzz.

Consumers reported slightly different usage patterns and damage extents, but consistently the iPhone Duo was folded only a few to a few dozen times; after the final opening a strange noise was heard at the hinge and a 3‑to‑5 cm crack appeared below, with a second crack vertically aligned with the tip of the first on the right side of the screen. Both cracks formed white pixel‑like bands and black spots of varying sizes near the intersection.
The problem may lie in the iPhone Duo’s hinge.

iFixit’s teardown report on the iPhone Duo, speculating on recent consumer‑reported screen failures, suggests the central support rod may not retract properly when the phone closes, applying excessive pressure to the display.
Additionally, the curved guide rail that directs hinge movement sits higher than surrounding components during folding; if the rail does not move as expected, it could also interfere with the screen.
According to a Monday, 26th report by Interface News, a Foxconn (2317‑TW) employee said the screen issue’s cause is broadly consistent with the above analyses.

The Foxconn employee added that, under tight capacity constraints, Apple had lowered certain yield quality‑control standards to ensure supply, which inevitably raises the likelihood of defective screens reaching the market.

Although Apple made a modest relaxation of standards, the actual incidence of iPhone Duo screen failures is not as high as imagined; dealers say problems are infrequent and no after‑sales issues have surfaced yet.

The Foxconn source said that, in response to the issue, the iPhone Duo production line has urgently swapped a batch of components, so current manufacturing is unaffected and inventory strategy remains unchanged. Channel sources say this year’s iPhone Duo stock will be around 7.5 million units.

items.title: 銘福開發與大馬Naza集團簽MOU 合攻城市採礦商機
items.title_en: Mingfu Development Signs MOU with Malaysia's Naza Group to Jointly Pursue Urban Mining Opportunities
paras: 旗下控有包括金聯成(7865-TW)等逾30家企業的銘福集團，在海外事業布局跨出重要一大步，銘福集團旗下的銘福開發今(26)日與與馬來西亞Naza集團旗下Naza Enviro控股簽署合作備忘錄(MOU)，雙方將就馬國當地環保產業園區的城市採礦商機，進行研議技術及營運合作。
在此一台灣銘福開發與大馬知名的回收控股企業的合作規劃中，未來再進一步延伸至電池回收等領域。
今天簽約典禮由合作雙方高層出席，包含銘福集團創辦人兼董事長陳福松、副董事長陳奕潔、成功集團創辦人陳志遠等受邀出席。
銘福集團指出，隨著馬來西亞汽車市場持續成長，報廢車輛（ELVs）與廢棄車輛的處置已成重要課題，馬來西亞政府正積極透過環境部（DOE）與道路運輸部（JPJ）完善相關監管法規，重塑馬來西亞廢棄車輛的處置模式，致力打造兼具高標準有害廢棄物處理、廢液抽取與高價值材料回收的全方位現代化園區。
Naza Enviro是馬來西亞知名的回收控股，為當地各級提供市政服務。據統計，馬來西亞一年新車銷售逾80萬輛，其中電動車銷售銷量顯著增加，隨著當地汽車使用與電動化持續發展，雙方合作發潛力備受看好。
銘福集團50年來在台灣從事報廢車輛拆解、金屬回收及再生材料處理。這次雙方選定的馬來西亞BTEP環保園區，目前已有廢棄物處理、水處理、掩埋氣發電等設施，雙方合作將從報廢車輛的前端去污染、拆解分類及後端材料回收著手，結合銘福專業的處理實績，及Naza Enviro的環境管理與園區營運能力，研議適合當地的業務合作方案。
銘福集團副董事長陳奕潔表示，銘福在台灣實績有目共睹，但不同國家市場仍要從當地法規、車輛來源和處理需求出發，未來與進一步Naza集團洽談鉛酸蓄電池、鋰電池回收、再生材料處理等領域合作。銘福集團旗下金聯成、名仁資源的專業實力，將提供後續合作的堅強基礎。
paras_en: Mingfu Group, which controls more than 30 companies including Jin Lian Cheng (7865‑TW), has taken a major step in its overseas expansion. Today (the 26th), Mingfu Development, a subsidiary of Mingfu Group, signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Naza Enviro Holdings, a unit of Malaysia's Naza Group. The two parties will explore technical and operational cooperation on urban mining opportunities in an environmental industrial park in Malaysia.
Under this cooperation plan between Taiwan's Mingfu Development and the well‑known Malaysian recycling holding company, the partnership may later extend to battery recycling and related fields.

The signing ceremony was attended by senior executives from both sides, including Mingfu Group founder and chairman Chen Fu‑song, vice chairman Chen Yi‑jie, and Cheng Chih‑yuan, founder of Cheng‑gong Group, who were invited to the event.

Mingfu Group noted that as Malaysia's automobile market continues to grow, the disposal of end‑of‑life vehicles (ELVs) and waste vehicles has become a critical issue. The Malaysian government is actively strengthening related regulatory frameworks through the Department of Environment (DOE) and the Road Transport Department (JPJ) to reshape the country's vehicle waste disposal model, aiming to build a modern, comprehensive park that meets high standards for hazardous waste treatment, fluid extraction, and high‑value material recovery.

Naza Enviro is a well‑known Malaysian recycling holding company that provides municipal services at all levels. Statistics show that Malaysia sells over 800,000 new cars annually, with electric‑vehicle sales rising sharply. As local vehicle usage and electrification continue to develop, the potential of the partnership is viewed very positively.

Mingfu Group has spent 50 years in Taiwan dismantling end‑of‑life vehicles, recycling metals and processing recycled materials. The Malaysian BTEP environmental park selected for this cooperation already has facilities for waste treatment, water treatment and landfill gas power generation. The collaboration will address pollution control, dismantling and sorting at the front end of ELVs and material recovery at the back end, combining Mingfu's proven processing expertise with Naza Enviro's environmental management and park‑operating capabilities to devise a business model suited to the local market.

Vice chairman Chen Yi‑jie said that Mingfu's achievements in Taiwan are evident, but each foreign market must start from local regulations, vehicle sources and processing needs. Future talks with Naza Group will explore cooperation in lead‑acid battery, lithium‑ion battery recycling and recycled material processing. The professional strengths of Mingfu’s subsidiaries Jin Lian Cheng and Ming‑ren Resources will provide a solid foundation for subsequent collaboration.

items.title: 外資狂賣3025億元台股不妙？野村估明年EPS成長29% 科技ETF展韌性
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Dump NT$302.5 B of Taiwan Stocks – Is a Market Slump Coming? Nomura Forecasts 29% EPS Growth in 2027, Tech ETFs Show Resilience
paras: 美國消費者物價指數高於市場預期引發升息疑慮，外資單日大舉賣超台股高達3025.55億元，創歷史紀錄，此外，薔琵颱風讓台股多休市一天，市場憂心本周調節與避險壓力湧現。野村投信指出，回顧歷史數據，外資大幅賣超後，台股多能回歸企業獲利與產業基本面。其中科技市值型指數中長期表現亮眼，其內部團隊估2027年企業每股盈餘成長率可達29%，顯示企業獲利能力具備強大支撐力，科技股長線仍具備回歸基本面的潛力。
近期國際總體經濟環境面臨挑戰，美國最新公布的通膨數據高於市場原先預期，使得美國聯準會的升息疑慮再度升溫，直接衝擊全球金融市場情緒。受此負面因素影響，台股日前遭到外資單日狂賣高達3025.55億元，一舉刷新歷史最高賣超紀錄，引發市場高度關注。
為釐清外資大賣後的台股走勢，野村投信針對歷史上外資單日賣超金額前十大事件進行統計分析。數據顯示，觀察後續20個、60個及120個交易日，台股加權指數平均總報酬分別達2.19%、19%與26.7%，呈現隨時間拉長逐步消化賣壓並回升的穩健趨勢。若轉向大型權值股，FTSE台灣50指數同期間平均總報酬分別為2.44%、20.63%及28.98%，皆優於整體加權指數。
若進一步聚焦於創新科技領域，TIP台灣創新科技50指數的漲勢更為突出。其在上述三個期間的平均總報酬分別高達3.68%、32.44%以及40.36%。特別是在120個交易日後，其平均表現更是大幅超越加權指數達13.66個百分點。歷史回測數據顯示，外資大幅調節後，具備產業競爭優勢的科技市值型企業，往往能在市場情緒回穩後展現強勁的反彈力道。
針對近期產業動態，野村台灣新科技50 ETF (00935-TW) 基金經理人林怡君指出，台股受全球利率高檔、人工智慧融資成本攀升及部分AI伺服器訂單遞延影響，短線波動加劇。但全球AI基礎建設的長期投資趨勢並未改變，大型雲端服務供應商依然持續擴大資本支出。隨著新一代Vera Rubin平台預期將於今年第四季末至明年第一季初逐步放量，加上客製化晶片出貨量成長，相關供應鏈明年第一季有望呈現淡季不淡。
根據野村投信內部台股股票池預估，2027年企業每股盈餘成長率大約可達29%，顯示企業獲利能力具備強大支撐力。不過林怡君提醒，在資金成本上升與產業內部競爭加劇的雙重壓力下，未來供應鏈表現可能進一步分化。唯有具備關鍵核心技術、擁有穩定接單能力及維持良好獲利品質的一線企業，才較有機會在激烈市場競爭中維持長期優勢。

隨著人工智慧應用由模型訓練延伸至終端推論，科技產業成長機會正輻射至先進封裝、電子零組件、高速傳輸及散熱等多元領域。林怡君建議，投資科技股應重視研發投入與技術競爭力。以00935追蹤的TIP台灣創新科技50指數為例，其結合FactSet創新科技產業分類，透過研發費用占營收比重、獲利條件、市值及股價動能等指標篩選50家企業。面對市場震盪，投資人可透過科技市值型ETF分散布局次產業，並採分批進場策略穩健掌握中長期發展機會。
paras_en: U.S. consumer price index data came in above market expectations, raising concerns about further rate hikes. Foreign investors sold a record NT$3025.55 billion of Taiwan stocks in a single day, the biggest net outflow ever. In addition, Typhoon Kong‑pi forced a market holiday, prompting worries that the week could see heightened correction and hedging pressure. Nomura Asset Management notes that historically, after large foreign sell‑offs the market tends to revert to corporate earnings and industry fundamentals. The mid‑ to long‑term performance of the technology‑cap weighted index has been especially strong, and its internal team projects a 29% corporate earnings‑per‑share growth rate by 2027, indicating robust profit support and long‑term upside for tech stocks.

The global macro environment has recently become more challenging. The latest U.S. inflation figures were higher than previously expected, reviving concerns that the Federal Reserve may raise rates again, which in turn dampened global market sentiment. As a result, Taiwan’s market experienced a massive single‑day foreign outflow of NT$3025.55 billion, setting a new record and drawing intense market attention.

To clarify how the market behaves after such foreign sell‑offs, Nomura analyzed the ten biggest single‑day foreign net‑sell events in history. Looking at the subsequent 20, 60 and 120 trading‑day windows, the Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Index delivered average total returns of 2.19%, 19% and 26.7% respectively, showing a steady trend of pressure being absorbed and prices rebounding over time. For large‑cap stocks, the FTSE Taiwan 50 Index posted even higher average returns over the same periods – 2.44%, 20.63% and 28.98% – outperforming the broader index.

Focusing on the innovative technology segment, the TIP Taiwan Innovative Technology 50 Index performed even better. Its average total returns over the three windows were 3.68%, 32.44% and 40.36%. Notably, after 120 trading days it outperformed the weighted index by 13.66 percentage points. Historical back‑tests show that after heavy foreign adjustments, technology‑cap companies with competitive advantages tend to rebound strongly once market sentiment stabilises.

Regarding recent industry dynamics, Lin Yi‑jun, portfolio manager of the Nomura Taiwan New Technology 50 ETF (00935‑TW), said that Taiwan’s market is facing heightened short‑term volatility due to high global rates, rising AI financing costs and some delayed AI server orders. However, the long‑term trend of global AI infrastructure investment remains unchanged, and large cloud service providers continue to expand capex. With the next‑generation Vera Rubin platform expected to ramp up from late Q4 2023 into early Q1 2024 and customized chip shipments growing, the supply chain is not expected to see a typical seasonal slowdown in Q1 2024.

Nomura’s internal Taiwan stock pool estimates corporate EPS growth of about 29% by 2027, underscoring strong profit fundamentals. Nonetheless, Lin cautions that rising funding costs and intensified intra‑industry competition could further differentiate supply‑chain performance. Only firms with core technologies, stable order pipelines and solid profit quality are likely to maintain a long‑term edge in a fiercely competitive market.

As AI applications expand from model training to edge inference, growth opportunities spread across advanced packaging, electronic components, high‑speed transmission and thermal solutions. Lin advises investors to focus on R&D spending and technological competitiveness when picking tech stocks. The TIP Taiwan Innovative Technology 50 Index, tracked by 00935, combines FactSet’s tech‑industry classification with filters on R&D intensity, profitability, market cap and price momentum to select 50 companies. In volatile markets, investors can diversify across sub‑sectors via tech‑cap ETFs and use staggered entry strategies to capture medium‑ to long‑term growth.

items.title: CCL廠騰輝電子泰國新廠今開幕 昆山同步投資15億元擴產
items.title_en: CCL's Tenghui Electronics Opens New Factory in Thailand, Simultaneously Expands Production in Kunshan with NT$1.5 Billion Investment
paras: CCL(銅箔基板)電子材料製造商騰輝電子-KY(6672-TW)今(26)日於泰國大城府Hi-Tech工業園區舉行新廠開幕典禮，正式啟用集團在東南亞首座生產基地。配合全球供應鏈重組及AI高算力、資料中心等新興應用發展，騰輝電子同步推進泰國廠後續產能建置及中國昆山15億元擴產計畫，進一步強化全球製造布局、供應鏈韌性與高階材料競爭力。
騰輝電子-KY泰國新廠開幕典禮由騰輝董事長王有慈、執行長鍾健人、董事邱奕誠及集團副總王琢共同主持。大城府最高行政長官—府尹查瓦寧（Chawanin Wongsattjirakan）並率領當地核心首長團隊隆重出席，共同見證集團全球策略布局的重要里程碑。
騰輝電子-KY泰國新廠占地約3.5萬平方公尺，主要生產銅箔基板及黏合片，目前已開始小量出貨，預計2026年底正式量產，後續上膠產能將於2027年陸續開出，屆時泰國廠總設計產能預計再提升15%。新廠將落實China+1策略，除服務既有車用電子客戶外，也為未來資料中心及高階電子材料需求預作布局。
騰輝電子-KY指出，因應AI、高階運算與資料中心市場發展，騰輝-KY已於9月17日經董事會通過15億元昆山擴產預算，預計2027年第二季開始量產。結合泰國與昆山雙基地布局，集團將進一步提升全球產能調度彈性，強化國際客戶供應能力。
騰輝電子-KY指出，公司長期深耕少量多樣、高度客製化的特殊電子材料市場，未來將持續發揮技術與產品差異化優勢，積極拓展車用電子、散熱材料、超高頻雷達、航太國防及AI高算力等高附加價值應用。
騰輝電子-KY執行長鍾健人表示，泰國新廠的啟用，是騰輝全球發展的重要里程碑，也代表騰輝電子-KY對國際客戶長期承諾的具體實踐。面對全球供應鏈重組與新世代電子技術快速發展，騰輝電子-KY將持續透過技術創新、特殊材料及彈性生產能力，為客戶創造更高價值，並積極掌握AI、高階運算與高附加價值電子材料的成長契機。
騰輝電子-KY透過泰國新廠啟用與昆山同步擴產，騰輝-KY將持續完善全球製造與供應體系，深化國際客戶合作，為集團長期成長注入新動能。

台灣印刷電路板協會(TPCA)預估 2026 年整體發展態勢明顯優於過去兩年，全年海內外總產值有望首度破兆，達 1 兆 1,365 億元，年增 24.2%。同時，包括華通(2313-TW)、金像電(2368-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)、臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)及敬鵬(2355-TW)、定穎(3715-TW)等大型 PCB 業者，都積極在泰國持續大力投資。而CCL廠聯茂(6213-TW)、騰輝電子及台燿(6274-TW)都已在泰國設廠生產。台光電(2383-TW)則設廠馬來西亞；甚至鑽針廠尖點(8021-TW)也在泰國設廠。

泰國目前為東南亞最大的 PCB 生產基地，2025 年 PCB 產值已達 50.6 億美元，年增 22.4%，占全球產值約 5.4%。其成長動能主要來自台資、陸資廠新產能開出，帶動 AI 伺服器、高速網通與衛星通訊等高階應用在泰國生產比重快速提升。預估在 AI 基礎建設需求延續、資料中心與雲端服務投資增加，以及全球供應鏈分散布局趨勢下，2026 年泰國 PCB 產值將進一步成長至 60.9 億美元，年增 20.4%。
泰國盤谷銀行董事資深執行副總裁谷塞浦達昆指出，泰國目前已居全球 PCB 產值前 5 名，在各方大力投資之下，預估很快將進入全球前 3 名。
paras_en: Tenghui Electronics-KY (6672-TW), a CCL (copper foil substrate) electronic materials manufacturer, held the opening ceremony today (26th) for its new plant in the Hi-Tech Industrial Park of Ayutthaya Province, Thailand, officially launching the group’s first production base in Southeast Asia. In line with the global supply‑chain restructuring and the development of AI high‑performance computing, data‑center and other emerging applications, Tenghui is simultaneously advancing further capacity construction at the Thailand site and a NT$1.5‑billion expansion project in Kunshan, China, to further strengthen its global manufacturing footprint, supply‑chain resilience and high‑end material competitiveness.

The opening ceremony of Tenghui Electronics‑KY’s Thailand plant was co‑hosted by Chairman Wang You‑ci, CEO Zhong Jian‑ren, Director Qiu Yi‑cheng and Deputy General Manager Wang Zhu. The highest provincial official of Ayutthaya, Governor Chawanin Wongsattjirakan, attended with a core local leadership team, jointly witnessing this key milestone in the group’s global strategic layout.

The Thailand plant occupies about 35,000 square metres and mainly produces copper‑foil substrates and adhesive sheets. Small‑scale shipments have already begun, with full‑scale mass production slated for the end of 2026. Subsequent adhesive‑coating capacity will be rolled out throughout 2027, raising the plant’s total design capacity by roughly 15%. The new facility implements the “China+1” strategy, serving existing automotive‑electronics customers while also positioning for future data‑center and high‑end electronic material demand.

Tenghui Electronics‑KY noted that, in response to AI, high‑performance computing and data‑center market growth, the board approved a NT$1.5‑billion expansion budget for Kunshan on September 17, with mass production expected to start in Q2 2027. By combining the dual‑base layout in Thailand and Kunshan, the group will further enhance global capacity‑allocation flexibility and strengthen supply capabilities for international customers.

The company emphasized its long‑term focus on a niche market of low‑volume, highly customized special electronic materials. Going forward, it will continue to leverage its technology and product differentiation to actively expand into high‑value‑add applications such as automotive electronics, thermal management materials, ultra‑high‑frequency radar, aerospace‑defense and AI high‑performance computing.

CEO Zhong Jian‑ren said the commissioning of the Thailand plant is a major milestone in Tenghui’s global development and a concrete demonstration of the company’s long‑term commitment to international customers. Facing global supply‑chain reshuffling and rapid advances in next‑generation electronic technologies, Tenghui will keep creating higher value for customers through technological innovation, specialty materials and flexible production capacity, while seizing growth opportunities in AI, high‑performance computing and high‑value‑add electronic materials.

Through the launch of the Thailand plant and the simultaneous Kunshan expansion, Tenghui‑KY will continue to perfect its global manufacturing and supply system, deepen cooperation with international customers, and inject new momentum into the group’s long‑term growth.

The Taiwan Printed Circuit Board Association (TPCA) forecasts that the overall development outlook for 2026 will be markedly better than the past two years, with total domestic and overseas output expected to break the trillion‑NTD mark for the first time, reaching NT$1.1365 trillion, a 24.2% year‑over‑year increase. At the same time, major PCB players such as Wistron (2313‑TW), Kingboard (2368‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW), Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW), Jing Peng (2355‑TW) and Ding Ying (3715‑TW) are all heavily investing in Thailand. CCL’s Lianmao (6213‑TW), Tenghui Electronics and Tai Yao (6274‑TW) have already set up production facilities in Thailand, while Tai Guang Electronics (2383‑TW) has established a plant in Malaysia.

Thailand is currently the largest PCB manufacturing hub in Southeast Asia. In 2025, PCB output there reached US$5.06 billion, up 22.4% year‑on‑year, accounting for about 5.4% of global output. Growth is driven mainly by new capacity from Taiwanese and Chinese investors, boosting the share of high‑end applications such as AI servers, high‑speed networking and satellite communications produced in Thailand. It is projected that, with continued AI infrastructure demand, increased data‑center and cloud‑service investments, and the trend toward diversified global supply chains, Thailand’s PCB output will rise to US$6.09 billion in 2026, a 20.4% annual increase.

Senior Executive Vice President Gu Sepu Dakuan of Thailand’s Bank of Ayutthaya said Thailand now ranks among the top five PCB producers worldwide and, with strong investment from all sides, is expected to soon enter the global top three.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone Duo需求爆發！追加三成訂單  鴻海、台積電、新日興受惠
items.title_en: Apple iPhone Duo Demand Explodes! Apple Adds 30% More Orders; Foxconn, TSMC and Xinri Xing Set to Benefit
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 開賣後需求超出預期，供貨短缺促使蘋果要求供應鏈加快生產，並追加三成訂單。隨著今年備貨量預估從原先的 600 萬支上修至 800 萬至 1,000 萬支，鴻海(2317-TW) 、台積電(2330-TW) 及新日興(3376-TW) 等供應鏈廠商可望受惠，鉸鏈產能與整機組裝良率則成為後續出貨能否擴大的關鍵。
iPhone Duo 於 10 月 23 日正式開賣，首日各機型即全數售罄，第二波出貨時間預計延至 2027 年 1 月 22 日。供需失衡也推升二手市場價格，轉售價格一度達 3,068 美元，較最低入手價 2,300 美元高出約 33%，反映市場需求強勁。
隨著銷售表現優於預期，多家市調機構已上修 iPhone Duo 出貨預估，2027 年出貨量更上看 3,300 萬支。
iPhone Duo 開賣後迅速售罄，顯示首波備貨未能滿足市場需求。業界分析，供貨不足除了與消費者需求超出預期有關，也受到組裝良率及零組件產能限制。
蘋果因此要求供應鏈加快生產並追加三成訂單，希望盡快補足供貨缺口。對消費性電子產品而言，上市後的銷售時間與市場滲透速度相當重要，若交貨等待時間過長，可能不利於擴大市占率。
從供應鏈分工來看，鴻海負責 iPhone Duo 整機組裝，核心處理器由台積電代工，攸關摺疊手機開闔與結構設計的鉸鏈零組件，則由鴻海與新日興的合資公司供應，美商安費諾(APH-US) 為第二供應商。
業界指出，目前產能瓶頸主要來自鉸鏈供應受限，加上摺疊手機的整機組裝難度較高，良率改善將是提升出貨量的重要因素。
若良率問題能盡快突破，缺貨狀況將有效緩解，消費者等待週期可望縮短，鴻海、台積電、新日興等供應鏈廠商的業績也將隨之顯著受益。
iPhone Duo 的銷售表現也可能改變全球摺疊手機市場的競爭格局。市調機構預估，蘋果在2027年將拿下全球摺疊機市場約四成佔有率，對三星(005930KS) 的市場主導地位構成直接衝擊。
蘋果加入戰局，也可能促使其他智慧型手機品牌加大摺疊機產品布局，進一步帶動市場關注與產品開發。
分析指出，對供應鏈而言，若摺疊手機需求持續成長，相關零組件與組裝業者將有機會獲得更多訂單。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) ’s first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, has seen demand exceed expectations after launch, prompting a supply shortage that led Apple to ask its supply chain to speed up production and add 30% more orders. With the year‑end inventory forecast raised from the original 6 million units to between 8 million and 10 million units, suppliers such as Foxconn (2317‑TW), TSMC (2330‑TW) and Xinri Xing (3376‑TW) are expected to benefit, while hinge capacity and overall device‑assembly yield will be critical to whether shipments can be further expanded.

The iPhone Duo officially went on sale on October 23, and every model sold out on day one; the second wave of shipments is now slated for January 22, 2027. The supply‑demand imbalance also pushed up second‑hand market prices, with resale prices briefly reaching $3,068—about 33% higher than the lowest purchase price of $2,300—reflecting strong market demand.
Because sales are outperforming expectations, several market‑research firms have raised their iPhone Duo shipment forecasts, with 2027 shipments now projected to reach as high as 33 million units.

The rapid sell‑out of the iPhone Duo after launch shows that the initial stock was insufficient to meet market demand. Industry analysts say the shortage is not only due to higher‑than‑expected consumer demand but also to constraints in assembly yield and component‑capacity limits.

Apple therefore asked its supply chain to accelerate production and add a 30% order increase, hoping to quickly close the supply gap. For consumer electronics, the post‑launch sales window and market‑penetration speed are crucial; overly long delivery waits could hinder market‑share expansion.

In terms of supply‑chain roles, Foxconn handles full‑device assembly of the iPhone Duo, the core processor is fabricated by TSMC, and the hinge components—critical to the foldable phone’s opening and structural design—are supplied by a joint venture between Foxconn and Xinri Xing, with Amphenol (APH-US) serving as a secondary supplier.

Industry sources point out that the current capacity bottleneck mainly stems from limited hinge supply, and because foldable phones are harder to assemble, improving yield will be a key factor in boosting shipment volumes.

If the yield issue can be quickly resolved, the shortage will ease, consumer wait times should shorten, and the earnings of supply‑chain firms such as Foxconn, TSMC and Xinri Xing are expected to improve markedly.

The iPhone Duo’s sales performance could also reshape the competitive landscape of the global foldable‑phone market. Research firms estimate that Apple will capture roughly 40% of the worldwide foldable‑phone market in 2027, delivering a direct hit to Samsung’s (005930KS) market‑leadership position.
Apple’s entry into the foldable segment may also prompt other smartphone brands to expand their foldable‑phone offerings, further driving market attention and product development.
Analysts note that for the supply chain, sustained growth in foldable‑phone demand would give component and assembly manufacturers the opportunity to secure additional orders.

paras_en: October 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – On Monday, October 26, the three major U.S. indices all closed in the green. Anthropic filed for an initial public offering (IPO), lifting sentiment for AI‑related stocks, while semiconductor and optical‑communication shares led the gains. Amid recent market turbulence and some companies postponing listings, the firm is still pushing ahead with its public‑offering plan. AI‑investment themes this month have been weighed down by rising borrowing costs and concerns over debt‑driven expansion, but the optimism generated by the filing helped newer cloud players such as CoreWeave recover intraday losses.

Optical‑product makers Lumentum and Coherent jumped about 8% and 6% respectively, ranking among the strongest performers in the S&P 500; technology stocks rose 1.5%, the top gain among the 11 sector groups. Most large‑cap and growth stocks advanced, with Tesla up 5.2% after Barclays upgraded its rating from “Neutral” to “Overweight,” taking the stock to a three‑month high.

Meta fell 1.9% against the trend. The company announced plans to raise up to $95 billion (about NT$3.1 trillion) through equity financing to fund data‑center, cloud‑computing and other AI infrastructure expansion.

More than one‑third of the S&P 500 constituents will report earnings this week, including Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon. items.title: 〈美股盤後〉Anthropic IPO重燃AI熱情 晶片股反攻 費半勁揚約3%
items.title_en: <US After-Hours> Anthropic IPO Rekindles AI Enthusiasm, Chip Stocks Rally, Philly Semiconductor Index Up About 3%
paras: Anthropic 提交首次公開發行 (IPO) 申請，重新點燃人工智慧 (AI) 投資熱情，加上油價回落緩解通膨疑慮，美股主要指數週一 (26 日) 同步收高。道瓊上漲逾 146 點，標普500指數漲0.70%，終止連兩個交易日跌勢，美光等晶片股強彈，那斯達克指數上揚約0.8%，費半勁揚近3%。
Claude 開發商 Anthropic 公開提交 IPO 申請，計劃以「ANT」為股票代碼在那斯達克掛牌，為近期承壓的 AI 題材注入信心，帶動晶片股領漲。
申報文件顯示，公司上半年營收達162.9億美元，較去年同期暴增約 13 倍。在市場擔憂資料中心支出難以持續、標普500與那指連續兩週收跌之際，這起上市案也將成為檢驗投資人對 AI 產業信心的重要指標。
布蘭特油價上週五一度升至4月以來最高，當時有報導指出，美國與以色列可能在期中選舉後對伊朗發動攻擊。儘管國際油價週一回落，中東供應風險仍未消退，美國戰略石油準備上週降至2.826億桶，為1982年10月以來最低。
投資人本週將迎接科技巨頭財報與聯準會 (Fed) 利率決議。本週有163家標普500成分企業預定公布第3季業績，其中包括 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)。在 Meta 上週財報引發市場不安後，華爾街將特別關注這些公司的 AI 支出展望、投資回報與融資需求。
Fed 則將於週三公布利率決議。聯邦基金利率期貨顯示，市場預估維持利率在3.75%至4%區間的機率約90%，主席華許對通膨與後續升息的說法將是焦點。
美股週一 (26 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.88%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 1.10%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 1.06%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 1.54%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 0.44%。
半導體主要個股全面收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 2.80%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 2.33%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 上漲 2.39%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 2.74%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 2.10%。
記憶體與儲存族群普升。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.98%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 大漲 3.63%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 上漲 1.42%；希捷 (STX-US) 上漲 2.18%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 勁揚 4.09%。
台股 ADR 漲多跌少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 上漲 1.40%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 大漲 3.15%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 1.54%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.76%。
企業新聞
巴西總統魯拉在週日總統大選中意外勝出，巴西企業在美上市股票重挫。啤酒商 Ambev (ABEV-US) 暴跌超14%，巴西石油公司 (PBR-US) 慘崩約 14%，投資管理公司 XP (XP-US) 跌超48%，近乎腰斬。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲1.5% 至每股 532.60 美元。公司將向約6萬名員工提供自願離職補償方案，相當於全職員工總數約27%，藉此降低成本，並調整 AI 時代的人力配置。
SpaceX (SPCX-US) 下跌0.4%至每股 146.90 美元。公司與阿波羅全球管理公司達成約400億美元設備融資租賃協議，用於取得 AI 晶片。
馬斯克還表示，提供 AI 算力服務的新型雲端業者，將面臨他形容如「小魚般大量死亡、相互整併」的洗牌，因為債市已不再願意借錢給這些公司。
不過，相關個股漲跌互見。CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 上漲約1.8%，IREN (IREN-US) 上漲2.1%，Nebius (NBIS-US) 則大跌3.5%。
Meta (META-US) 下跌1.9% 至每股 630.56 美元。公司計劃透過普通股與特別股籌資，總額最高達950億美元，支持 AI 發展。其中，近期將發行350億美元股票，明年還可能再發行600億美元股票。
華爾街分析
Freedom Capital Markets 市場策略師 Jay Woods 表示，市場需要 Anthropic 這類消息提振信心，就如同先前的 SpaceX。他預期，這起備受期待的上市案將吸引投資需求。
盈透證券首席策略師 Steve Sosnick 也指出，Anthropic 重新喚起市場近幾週缺乏的 AI 熱情，這起 IPO 將是檢驗投資人態度與承接意願的重要測試。
不過，Treasury Partners 創始合夥人兼投資長 Richard Saperstein 認為，科技巨頭財報的關鍵，在於未來打算投入多少 AI 支出，以及營運現金流是否足以支應，或仍需透過發股與舉債籌資。
對於 Fed，他預期週三不會升息，因為自上次會議以來，債市已透過殖利率上升收緊信用條件。他預期 Fed 將對通膨維持強硬措辭，但政策行動相對溫和。
信安資產管理的 Seema Shah 則認為，這一輪緊縮主要回應能源帶動的通膨與匯率變化，並非經濟明顯過熱，因此升息循環可能相對有限，但她仍預期 Fed 將於12月升息，並在2027年再升息一次。
